skill.summary: generate video clips into green screen footage with this skill. Works with MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB. video editors, content creators, YouTubers...

latestVersion.changelog:
generator-green-screen 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate green screen video footage from MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Upload video clips and receive processed 1080p MP4 files with green backgrounds, ready for editing.
- All processing is cloud-based; setup includes automatic token and session management.
- Supports basic prompt-based editing, batch processing, previews, and exporting.
- File uploads, credit checks, and status queries are mapped to intuitive user prompts.
- Provides clear error messages and summarizes editing operations for a seamless workflow.
